articles.title: For most things, Claude actually doesn’t need its J-space. If we delete the J-space, Claude still speaks fluently, recalls facts, and classifies text—but becomes bad at some tasks like multi-step…
articles.author: Anthropic · @AnthropicAI
articles.summary: For most things, Claude actually doesn’t need its J-space. If we delete the J-space, Claude still speaks fluently, recalls facts, and classifies text—but becomes bad at some tasks like multi-step reasoning. It’s similar to deliberate vs. automatic processing in human cognition.
